subject.title: experimental.sessionMemory does not surface gateway-dispatched sessions in memory_search

question: Should #53550 be resolved by keeping session `memory_search` tied to session-tool visibility plus narrow bug fixes, or by adding a separate owner-controlled private-conversation recall capability?
rationale: The source shows a real session recall failure mode, but widening visibility also changes a transcript privacy boundary, so automation should not choose the permanent product model.

options.title: Keep boundary and land narrow fixes
options.body: Maintain the current fail-closed session visibility model, review #92261 for the live-orphan bug class, and keep broader recall behind the separate maintainer product path.

options.title: Adopt remember-across-conversations
options.body: Treat #99611/#100140 as the canonical product solution for personal assistants that should recall across private conversations without broadening session tools.

options.title: Documentation-only closure
options.body: Close this as current configured behavior and rely on docs/doctor warnings, accepting that same-assistant private recall remains an advanced manual setup.

recommendation.title: Keep boundary and land narrow fixes
recommendation.body: Maintain the current fail-closed session visibility model, review #92261 for the live-orphan bug class, and keep broader recall behind the separate maintainer product path.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current maintainer-authored product-direction issue/PR for the narrower private-conversation recall mode that decides the unresolved policy question.
